said: This looks fantastic! So we need to still reduce it more for it to drive?
findingsShown: weight: 24,522 triangles against a budget of 15,000
grille: a streaky smear, not slats
body sides: slightly wavy along the doors and sills up close
windows: opaque dark paint, no interior; the driver sits hidden inside the body
wheels: part of the body, so they do not turn
surface: made matte by changing the texture's roughness to 0.85 and metal to 0; not yet seen in Studio
note: Said after importing StudioImport/RedSuvMatte.glb, this exact build, into Studio. Asked in the same message whether it must be reduced further.
